_comment: Themed grouping for INDEX.md. Each member is a skill id of the form '<source>/<skill>' matching a source id + skill name in MANIFEST.json (bodies live upstream, not in this repo). build-index.mjs renders groups in this order, auto-extracts each skill's name/description from its SKILL.md YAML frontmatter, and lists any manifest skill NOT named here under an 'Uncategorized' section so newly synced skills surface loudly. When a source adds a skill, file its id into the right group below.
_unpinnedComment: Upstream skill directories we deliberately DO NOT pin, per cherry-picked source. update.sh's pick list is hard-coded, so without this an upstream sibling published later would never be pinned and nothing would ever say so. check-skills-drift.mjs fails when a source has an upstream directory that is neither pinned nor listed here — so adding a skill upstream forces an explicit decision (pin it, or record why not) instead of silence. Each entry is a reason keyed by directory name.

groups.title: Ecosystem research & routing
groups.description: Stellar-ecosystem analyst skills — survey/map a sector, profile a project, digest recent activity, position an SCF idea, audit content, find an integration, or scout prior art. The richest playbooks in the catalog: multi-step gather routines an LLM runs via `execute` over the lumenloop and scout adapters.

groups.title: Soroban & smart contracts
groups.description: Writing, securing, and upgrading Stellar smart contracts (SDF smart-contracts skill — formerly branded Soroban — + OpenZeppelin's Stellar contract skills). Execution micro-skill candidates for any contract-aware gather path.

groups.title: Stellar app dev & data
groups.description: SDF's developer skills for building on Stellar off-chain: dapps/wallets, chain data via RPC/Horizon, classic assets + SAC, agentic payments, cross-chain rails, SEP/standards, and ZK. Reference + selective execution micro-skill candidates.
